<p class="interests-lead">I have a wandering mind. Discover here what I am sometimes up to.</p>

<details id="community-service" class="interest-section interest-section--community">
<summary><span class="interest-section-label"><i class="bi bi-people" aria-hidden="true"></i>Community service</span></summary>
<div class="interest-section-content">
<article class="community-article">
<h3>Monmua: skills training for women</h3>
<div class="community-article__body">
<div class="community-article__text">
<p class="community-article__meta">Sorbelle, Sissala West District, Ghana · 2021</p>
<p>In 2021, I worked with three fellow Mastercard Foundation Scholars to train 20 women in making household detergents. The two-week programme aimed to provide an additional source of income alongside seasonal farming.</p>
<p>Follow-up showed that limited startup capital made it difficult for some participants to start or expand a business, highlighting the need to pair practical skills with financial support.</p>
</div>
<div class="community-article__photos">
<figure><img src="images/community-service/monmua-group.jpg" alt="Monmua participants with the household products they made in Sorbelle" width="2048" height="922" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
<figure><img src="images/community-service/monmua-training.jpg" alt="Women taking part in the Monmua detergent-making training" width="1280" height="302" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
</div>
</div>
</article>

<article class="community-article">
<h3>UST Info Hub: student mentoring</h3>
<div class="community-article__body">
<div class="community-article__text">
<p>I advised more than 200 prospective students on university applications, course choices, and admission requirements, and mentored 200 newly admitted students as they prepared for campus life.</p>
<p>This included guidance on registration and housing, alongside mentorship plans pairing new students with current students to support their academic and social transition.</p>
</div>
<div class="community-article__photos">
<figure><img src="images/community-service/ust-info-hub.jpg" alt="UST Info Hub poster featuring Abdul Baari Bakpa and fellow student advisers" width="1080" height="607" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
</div>
</div>
</article>

<article class="community-article">
<h3>Youth Opportunities: Global Youth Ambassador</h3>
<div class="community-article__body">
<div class="community-article__text">
<p>As a Global Youth Ambassador for Youth Opportunities, my work has included sharing scholarships, conferences, and competitions; supporting an online youth community; and helping organise sessions on applications and professional development.</p>
<p>Through partnerships, events, and contributions to the Circle platform, I have helped young people find and navigate educational and career opportunities.</p>
</div>
<div class="community-article__photos community-article__photos--portrait">
<figure><img src="images/community-service/youth-opportunities.jpg" alt="Youth Opportunities Global Ambassador Program 2023 poster for Abdul Baari Bakpa, Ghana" width="575" height="720" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
</div>
</div>
</article>

<p><a href="https://sites.google.com/view/mrbakpa/community-service">More about my community service</a></p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="interest-section interest-section--statafun">
<summary><span class="interest-section-label"><svg class="stata-icon" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><rect class="stata-icon-bg" x="1" y="1" width="30" height="30" rx="6"/><path d="M12 7h5v5h-5zM19 7h5v5h-5zM5 14h5v5H5zM12 14h5v5h-5zM19 14h5v5h-5zM5 21h5v5H5zM12 21h5v5h-5z" fill="#fff"/></svg>Statafun</span></summary>
<div class="interest-section-content">
<p>Even the busiest minds need a little fun.</p>
<p>Inspired by the Stata packages <code>motivate</code> and <code>demotivate</code>, I created <code>statafun</code> to bring a little fun to coding tasks. It offers jokes, anagrams, and riddles right inside Stata, even without an internet connection.</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/abdulbaaribakpa/statafun">Explore statafun on GitHub</a></p>
</div>
</details>
